title: 5-Day Sri Lanka Highlights
intro: Discover the highlights of Sri Lanka on a private 5-day journey through ancient heritage, beautiful mountains, tea country and the tropical south coast.
audience: A great choice for first-time visitors who want to experience Sri Lanka’s culture, nature and scenery in a short time.

plan.title: Colombo / Negombo
plan.description: Airport pickup and explore Colombo or the relaxed coastal town of Negombo.

plan.title: Sigiriya & Dambulla
plan.description: Visit the ancient Sigiriya Rock Fortress and explore the beautiful Dambulla Cave Temple.

plan.title: Kandy
plan.description: Travel to Kandy and discover the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Kandy Lake and the surrounding hills.

plan.title: Nuwara Eliya & Ella
plan.description: Enjoy scenic mountain roads, waterfalls and tea plantations before continuing to Ella.

plan.title: Ella & South Coast
plan.description: Visit the famous Nine Arch Bridge and enjoy the beautiful scenery before travelling towards the southern beaches.
